subject: Problem removing the text for geom_text

messages.author: 4a5b9f6ca76abfa1
messages.subject: Problem removing the text for geom_text
parts:
Dear List,

I have a problem with removing the legend for the geom_text() element in
the following plot. I just want the legend for "Countries with Highest
Values" and not the legend with "in" and "out" (These are artificial
variables created to specify the color of the text). I am wondering if
there is a way of simply removing the legend or an elegant method for
creating text inside and out side the bar with different color depending
on the value.

In addition, is there a way to reduce the vertical spacing between the
two line of text created by "\n"? The space between "Central" and
"Africa Rep." is larger then I want it to be, and it will be hard for
the readers to distinguish between "Paraguay" and "Central Africa Rep."


## Read in the data
test.df <- read.csv("http://dl.dropbox.com/u/18161931/test.csv",
stringsAsFactor = FALSE)

## Create factors for ordering the plot
test.df$CountryName <- factor(test.df$CountryName,
levels = arrange(test.df,
test.df$Value)$CountryName)

## Open a new device for the desired output size
dev.new(width = 4, height = 8)

## Create the plot
ggplot(test.df, aes(x = CountryName, y = Value)) +
geom_bar(aes(fill = Level)) +
geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", Value),
hjust = ifelse(Value >= bound, 1, 0),
col = breakCol), size = 2.5, legend = FALSE) +
coord_flip() + xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL) +
opts(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "horizontal",
legend.title = NULL) +
scale_color_manual(value = c("White", "Black"))

Any help is greatly appreciated, many thanks in advance!

Cheers,
